title: Titanium Neuro Guidewire
alloyReason: Nitinol (Ni-Ti shape memory alloy) provides the unique superelasticity required for self-expanding stents and TAVI frames. The alloy undergoes martensitic transformation at body temperature.
commonFailures: Austenite finish temperature (Af) must be tuned to 25+-3C for self-expanding behavior at body temperature
Surface defects >5um after electropolishing can cause fatigue crack initiation
seoTitle: Titanium Neuro Guidewire - Nitinol (ASTM F2063) - Precision CNC Titanium Component
seoDescription: Titanium Neuro Guidewire - Neurovascular micro-guidewire core (Nitinol) Manufactured from Nitinol (ASTM F2063). Precision CNC machined with Laser micro-cutting, Shape-setting heat treatment, Electropolishing. AS9100D & ISO 9001 certified.
